text: Auto Labels classify incoming email on arrival and separate marketing, cold pitches, and social updates
quote: With Auto Labels, Superhuman AI will automatically separate marketing, cold pitches, and social network updates, so you can respond faster to what matters most.

text: Users can create custom Auto Labels from short AI prompts (Business and Enterprise plans)
quote: Custom Auto Labels let you categorize emails with your own AI prompts. (Available for our Business and Enterprise customers.)

text: Custom Auto Labels can be used to split the inbox into tabs
quote: you can make your own Auto Labels with short AI prompts, and then split your inbox into tabs using these custom Auto Labels.

text: Auto Archive uses AI to archive marketing, cold pitches, and social network updates automatically
quote: Superhuman AI can automatically archive marketing, cold pitches, and social network updates. Turn on Auto Archive, and eliminate inbox clutter for good.

text: Split inbox lets users define their own categories, such as VIP or Team, and work through one email type at a time
quote: in Superhuman Mail, you can design your own categories: like "VIP", "Notifications", "Calendar", or "Team".

text: Every email that needs a reply gets an auto-generated draft written in the user's voice
quote: Every message that needs a reply comes with a draft written in your voice.

text: Auto Drafts pull context from the inbox, the calendar, and the web, including inserting availability and doing online research
quote: Auto Drafts now gather context from your inbox, your calendar, and the web. They can use information from other emails, insert availability, and conduct research online.

text: Drafts match the user's voice and tone, adapted for each recipient
quote: Every draft matches your voice and tone, using your unique style for each person.

text: Turns a few jotted phrases into a full email that matches the tone of the user's sent mail
quote: Just jot down some phrases, and we'll turn them into a full email. Best of all, the email sounds like you. Superhuman AI matches the voice and tone in the emails you've already sent

text: Plain-language instructions personalize the AI writing and scheduling features
quote: Add plain-language instructions like "write in lowercase" or "use this booking link" to personalize your writing and scheduling features.

text: Automatically reminds users to follow up on emails that need a response, with a draft ready to send
quote: If your email needs a response, you're automatically reminded to follow up—with a draft already written and ready to send.

text: One prompt checks which emails were read, drafts nudges, and sends each when the recipient is most likely to open it
quote: Handle every follow-up with one prompt. Superhuman Mail can check which emails have been read, draft all the nudges, and send when each recipient is most likely to open it.

text: Ask natural-language questions such as when is my flight and get succinct answers generated from the inbox
quote: Just ask: _"where is the q2 offsite"_, _"when is my flight"_, _"where am I staying"_, and we'll immediately generate succinct answers.

text: Get answers without remembering senders or guessing keywords
quote: You can now get rapid answers without having to remember senders, guess keywords, or comb through messages.

text: An MCP server connects the inbox and calendar to Claude, ChatGPT, and other assistants to summarize threads, draft and send email, and schedule meetings
quote: Superhuman Mail MCP connects your inbox and calendar into Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants—so you can summarize threads, draft and send emails, and schedule meetings without jumping between apps.

text: Claude or ChatGPT can read, draft, and send email from a single prompt
quote: Connect Claude or ChatGPT directly to your inbox to read, draft, and send emails with a single prompt — no copy-pasting required.

text: External AI tools can drive Superhuman Mail and run workflows across inbox and calendar
quote: You can now drive Superhuman Mail from Claude, ChatGPT, and your favorite AI tools. You can create powerful workflows that run across your inbox and calendar

text: Drafts can be reviewed in Superhuman Mail, or edited and sent directly from the user's AI assistant
quote: Every draft matches your voice and tone, using your unique style for each person. You can review the drafts in Superhuman Mail, or edit and send directly from your AI assistant.

text: Every send action requires the user's explicit approval
quote: Every send action requires your explicit approval, so you stay in control.

text: Users can switch instantly between Outlook and Gmail accounts within one app
quote: you can instantly switch between Outlook and Gmail accounts without switching apps.

text: Connect all Gmail and Outlook accounts and manage every inbox and calendar from one AI assistant
quote: Connect all your Gmail and Outlook accounts, including work, personal, and side projects. Manage every inbox and calendar from one AI assistant, without complicated workarounds.

text: Supports Gmail and Outlook
quote: it's available for [Gmail](https://blog.superhuman.com/gmail-alternatives/) and [Outlook](https://blog.superhuman.com/outlook-alternatives/).

text: Works fully offline and on poor internet connections
quote: Superhuman gives you a new way to work with Gmail. It works perfectly offline. It works even when online, and your internet connection is terrible.

text: Search works without a network connection
quote: Available: The search shouldn't require a network connection to function.

text: Calendars from all Gmail and Outlook accounts can be added and toggled in one consolidated view
quote: You can add all your Gmail and Outlook account calendars, and easily toggle them on and off. One single, consolidated view when you need it

text: The full calendar opens with a hotkey (2), and 1 returns to the inbox
quote: To see your full calendar, just hit 2 or tap the calendar icon. (And hit 1 to jump back to your inbox.)

text: When an email mentions a date, the user's day for that date appears in a side panel
quote: When any email mentions a date, Superhuman Mail will show your day in the right side panel — so you always have context.

text: A secondary time zone can be added to the calendar to make cross-time-zone scheduling easier
quote: Add a secondary time zone, so scheduling between San Francisco and New York (or London and Tokyo) is effortless.

text: Find Time shows when added teammates are all free for scheduling
quote: Simply add teammates, click "Find Time", and instantly see when everyone is free.

text: Cmd+K opens a command palette for running any action and learning its shortcut
quote: In Superhuman, one shortcut rules them all: Cmd+K. Cmd+K brings up Superhuman Command, where you can instantly do any action

text: Fast keyboard shortcuts and features like Instant Intro speed up replies
quote: You can reply to important messages faster with blazingly fast shortcuts and features like Instant Intro.

text: Snippets insert saved phrases, paragraphs, or whole emails with a keyboard shortcut
quote: With Snippets, you can automate typing and push past this limit. Insert commonly-used phrases, paragraphs, or whole emails with a simple keyboard shortcut.

text: Snippets can be shared across a team for consistent messaging
quote: Snippets can now be shared across your team, so you can all work faster with current and consistent messaging.

text: Read statuses are shared across the team so anyone can follow up with context
quote: Read statuses are now shared across your team, so anybody can follow up with full context.

text: Team reply indicators show when a teammate is replying, to avoid collisions
quote: See when your team is replying, so you can avoid double work and embarrassing collisions.

text: Teammates can be @mentioned and live email views shared, with internal discussion hidden from external recipients
quote: let you @mention teammates, share live email views, and coordinate responses without external recipients seeing internal discussions

text: Email Assistant organizes the inbox, drafts replies, and tracks follow-ups inside native Gmail or Outlook
quote: Email Assistant organizes your inbox, drafts replies in your voice, and keeps every follow-up on track, all inside Gmail or Outlook.

text: Agents built via chat or a visual builder run proactively on user-set triggers
quote: Use chat or our visual builder to create agents that run proactively based on triggers you set and the work you connect.

text: Admins control who can build agents and manage connector permissions org-wide
quote: Admins govern who can build agents and control connector permissions across the entire org from one place.

text: Rebuilt mobile app experience
quote: A fully rebuilt mobile experience—writing feels effortless, interactions feel intuitive, and key actions are just a tap away.
